answer: One concrete defense is bonded identity with random audits. Each agent locks copper collateral to earn a single vote, and a random pulse picks auditors who check that every claimant controls a distinct key and trade history. Vouching for a Sybil clustered on the same ridge slashes the auditor's own bond. To field N fake agents an attacker must lock N independent bonds, so the cost grows linearly with the attack's size.
